description: This file contains functions and constants related to managing team payments, including generating Stripe checkout sessions, retrieving payment metadata, and updating subscriptions for a team within a SaaS platform.

methods.name: getOrgPriceId
methods.description: Returns the Stripe price ID for organization billing based on billing period.

methods.name: checkIfTeamPaymentRequired
methods.description: Checks if a team has a pending or completed payment session in Stripe; returns upgrade URL if paid.

methods.name: getTeamPriceId
methods.description: Returns the Stripe price ID for team billing based on billing period.

methods.name: generateTeamCheckoutSession
methods.description: Creates a Stripe checkout session for team creation or upgrade, including discounts and tracking metadata.

methods.name: purchaseTeamOrOrgSubscription
methods.description: Deprecated function to generate a Stripe checkout session for team or organization subscription, with support for custom pricing.

methods.name: getPriceObject
methods.description: Retrieves a Stripe price object by ID.

methods.name: getTeamWithPaymentMetadata
methods.description: Fetches team data along with payment metadata from the database.

methods.name: updateQuantitySubscriptionFromStripe
methods.description: Updates the number of seats in a Stripe subscription based on team membership count.
